purpose: Three male hair art approval assets, not integrated into game

prompts.name: 01-curto-classico
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone male hair overlay asset for a professional 2D karate fighting game. Reference image is STYLE AND HEAD ANGLE ONLY: match its crisp hand-drawn arcade sprite ink contours, well-defined grouped cel shading, elegant anatomy and warm upper-left dojo light. Single hairstyle, a single three-quarter side view facing RIGHT, matching the bald adult's guard head angle. Output ONLY the actual hair silhouette, crown, fringe, temple hair and nape: the interior opening where face, ear and neck would be is fully transparent. NO head, NO face, NO skin, NO eyes, NO ear, NO neck, NO torso, NO gi, NO mannequin. No multiple views, no color variants, no text, no grid, no accessories, no 3D, no blur, no photoreal strands. Draw one large centered complete hair cutout with generous margins on genuinely transparent background. Refined clean dark contour, visible structured locks and 4-5 coherent luminance bands. Neutral dark chestnut brown preview color; all shading belongs to one recolorable hair material, no fixed colored reflections. Make volume and locks readable in black, blond, red, gray and white future palettes. High-quality 2D raster sprite artwork with confident clean edges and restrained texture, NOT blocky oversized pixel mosaic.
Hairstyle: Short classic masculine haircut: close neatly tapered sides, clean short nape, top slightly longer brushed to the right with a subtle side part and low gentle quiff, sculpted small locks, realistic restrained volume. The fringe faces right.
